name: Golem, Snow
body:
Snow Golem
CR 4

This enormous, lumpy snowman moves with a heavy, but steady gait.

XP 1,200
N Large construct (cold)
Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 8, flat-footed 13 (–1 Dex, +5 natural, –1 size)
hp 57 (5d10+30); snow repair
Fort +1, Ref +0, Will +1
Immune cold, construct traits, magic
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee slam +9 (1d6+7 plus 1d6 cold)
Ranged snowball +3 (1d6+5 plus 1d6 cold)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks cold (1d6), snowball effect

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 9, Con —, Int —, Wis 11, Cha 1
Base Atk +5; CMB +11; CMD 20

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Cold (Ex)

A snow golem’s form is extremely cold, dealing 1d6 cold damage with its attacks. Creatures attacking a snow golem unarmed or with natural weapons take this cold damage each time one of their attacks hits.

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

A snow golem is immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance, with the exception of spells and spell-like abilities that have the Fire descriptor, which affect it normally. In addition, certain spells and effects function differently against the creature, as noted below.

A magical attack that deals cold damage breaks any slow effect on the golem and heals 1 point of damage for every 3 points of damage the attack would otherwise deal. If the amount of healing would cause the golem to exceed its full normal hit points, it gains any excess as temporary hit points. A snow golem gets no saving throw against cold effects.

Snowball (Ex)

A snow golem can hurl a snowball as a ranged attack dealing bludgeoning damage. It has a range increment of 20 feet, with a maximum range of 100 feet. A creature hit by a snowball must succeed at a DC 14 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1 round. The save DC is Constitution-based and includes a +2 racial bonus.

Snowball Effect (Ex)

A snow golem leaves no tracks when traveling through snow and is immune to any penalties to movement or Perception that result from snow. A snowman charging through snow picks up additional material, adding significant weight and impact to its blow. For every snow-covered square the snow golem traverses during a charge, it gains a stacking +1 bonus on its attack and damage roll for this charge.

Snow Repair (Su)

A snow golem has fast healing 2 when in an area with a high concentration of snow.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary or gang (2–4)
Treasure none

Less sophisticated but easier to make than an ice golem, the snow golem is a brutish mountain of overwhelming physical force. With the physical dimensions and strength of an ogre, it is a dependable defender for anyone dwelling in cold climates. Even though it’s made of heavy and frozen snow, it still remains considerably easier to damage than most golem variants, which is offset by its ease of repair and finding spare material, which these frigid bodyguards can easily manage on their own. While their main skill lies in pummeling opponents into paste, snow golems can also throw chunks of themselves at distant opponents with formidable accuracy and with no permanent harm to themselves.

While a snow golem can theoretically be crafted to be aesthetically pleasing, as a statue carved out of snow, most golem crafters don’t bother with bringing any flair and grandeur to an otherwise unimpressive feat of construct engineering. Most often, these better-looking snow golems are either made this way specifically at the behest of the buyer, or by first-time golem creators for whom the snow golem is a milestone achievement and a great challenge in its own right.

While hardly useful as guards or troops, smaller snow golems do exist. They are Medium, have 3 HD and are often decorated, similar to inanimate snowmen. These variant snow golems are most often used during various winter festivities.

Crafting a Snow Golem

The construction of a snow golem requires packed, solid snow weighing at least 2,500 pounds and treated with magical powders and unguents worth at least 250 gp.

CL 7th; Price 10,500 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Construct; Spells false life, lesser geas, minor creation, snowball; Special creator must be caster level 7th; Skill(s) Craft (sculptures) DC 15; Cost 5,375 gp
